visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The main creator, Joeman, sits in a ergonomic office chair wearing a white t-shirt and a black leather jacket. He smiles and gestures with a smartphone in his hand. The background is a well-lit office with a grey wall, glass partitions, and shelving filled with boxes and figurines. (2) A split-screen comparison displays two photos of Joeman making a peace sign on a smartphone. The top half is labeled 'iPhone 16 Pro' and the bottom 'S25 Ultra'. Joeman points his index finger at the screen to emphasize the comparison while looking at the camera. (3) Joeman uses his finger to circle his own hand on the smartphone screen. A progress circle appears with text saying 'Generating...'. The AI then removes the hand, creating a humorous visual glitch where the sleeve is empty and then replaced by a small finger-heart gesture. (4) In a new segment, Joeman circles his entire torso on the screen. The display flickers as the AI replaces his entire body and leather jacket with a simple grey long-sleeved shirt. He laughs excitedly and holds the phone closer to the camera to show the detail. (5) A final photo shows another man standing behind Joeman in a friendly pose. After AI processing, Joeman is completely removed from the frame, leaving only the other man standing alone in a slightly distorted office environment with blurred computer screens in the background.

SFX of a sharp 'camera shutter' click triggers as a photo comparison appears on screen. (2) A comedic 'boing' sound effect plays when the AI result is displayed, indicating a humorous failure. The host's voice exhibits high pitch variability and excitement, followed by loud, overlapping laughter from the host and another male presence. (3) The BGM continues with a consistent moderate tempo and synthesized bass. A 'magic chime' SFX accompanies the visual transformation of the host's outfit. The host maintains a very fast speech rate with minimal pauses. (4) The audio concludes with a high-energy exclamation of surprise and the sound of the rhythmic BGM fading out quickly alongside a final burst of laughter.
